page_title: RAY 1-0 ALA | Rayo Vallecano v Alaves 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' A bullet header by Carles Alena (Alaves) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post.
90+4' Jonny Otto (Alaves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Alemao is given a rest as he is replaced by Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
90+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Pep Chavarria and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:0.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
88' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
85' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla was alert and made an astonishing save!
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toni Martinez leaves the pitch and Jon Guridi (Alaves) comes on.
83' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Oscar Valentin is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Here comes a substitution. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Jorge de Frutos.
82' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

80' Lucas Boye (Alaves) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Augusto Batalla, who tips the ball around the post.
76' Toni Martinez (Alaves) blows a golden chance from inside the box, volleying the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a miss!
75' The attendance for today's match is 11734.
74' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by the defence.
72' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) attempts to discuss the decision with Victor Garcia, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
72' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' It will be a substitution. Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is ready to enter the pitch as Denis Suarez walks off.
67' What a shot! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the right post.

66' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom left corner from a promising distance, but Antonio Sivera denies him.
64' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
62' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Fran Perez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Here is a change. Unai Lopez is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Jonny Otto (Alaves) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.

58' Lucas Boye (Alaves) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Ander Guevara (Alaves) replaces Antonio Blanco.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Carlos Vicente.
54' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
53' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' A yellow-coloured card is received by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
52' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
46' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Victor Parada (Alaves) comes on the pitch for Jon Pacheco.
46' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' The game is interrupted now, Jon Pacheco (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

42' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Antonio Sivera, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
41' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Antonio Sivera has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
41' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
38' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
34' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
32' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
31' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
31' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged for offside.
28' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Victor Garcia didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
23' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) sends a first-time strike goalwards, but the effort goes yards wide of the right post.
20' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

19' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.
19' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
15' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
11' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
11' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
9' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
6' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

6' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
3' Close! Carles Alena (Alaves) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
2' Denis Suarez (Alaves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul after Yusi (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents.
